title: Claude launches first AI-based video editor with text #ClaudeAI #AIvideoediting #OpenSourceTech
description: Claude introduced the world’s first video editor powered entirely by AI, allowing users to edit full videos through simple text commands. The free, open-source app connects to Claude via MCP to organize files, trim clips, and remove silences instantly on a multi-track timeline designed for seamless AI integration. This innovation represents a major shift in video editing, combining traditional manual controls with AI-driven automation to streamline workflows and increase productivity. By enabling conversation-based editing, Claude sets a new standard for intuitive, flexible content creation in media production. The tool’s ability to handle complex edits while maintaining full control appeals to both professionals and enthusiasts, demonstrating how AI can reshape creative industries and maximize efficiency without sacrificing quality.
